policy: Lowest active variant level is shown for each source. Same source with a different translation has separate evidence. Structural QA never grants semantic or client verification.

definitions.untranslated: Missing or unresolved source in a current route.
definitions.ignore: Explicit decision to retain source; not language work.
definitions.unreviewed: Translation reused/imported without recorded source comparison.
definitions.source_reviewed: Recorded comparison with CN source; not necessarily checked in game.
definitions.client_verified: Specific source/target observed in game with recorded evidence.
